targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN os_name LIKE 'Windows%' THEN os_name
        ELSE CONCAT(os_name, ' ', os_version)
    END AS OS,
    COUNT(*) AS count
FROM
    nodes
GROUP BY
    OS;

panels.title: OS version repartition
Compliance breakdown

targets.rawSql:
WITH lowestComplianceNodes AS (
    -- Select the 5 nodes with the lowest compliance
    SELECT id
    FROM nodes
    WHERE timestamp = (SELECT MAX(timestamp) FROM nodes)
    ORDER BY compliance ASC  -- Use ASC for lowest compliance
    LIMIT 5
)
-- Fetch the rule compliance for these nodes
SELECT
    n.id,
    n.hostname,
    n.compliance as nodes_compliance,
    nir.rule_id,
    r.name,
    nir.compliance as rule_compliance

FROM
    nodes n

JOIN
    nodesInRules nir ON n.id = nir.id
JOIN
    lowestComplianceNodes lcn ON n.id = lcn.id
JOIN
    rules r on r.id = nir.rule_id
WHERE nir.compliance < 100

panels.title: Rules compliance over time

targets.rawSql:
WITH recentTimestamp AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        timestamp as date
    FROM
        directives
    ORDER BY date DESC limit 2
)
SELECT  r.name as "Directive name", AVG(r.success_repaired) as "Proportion of 'Repaired' (%)"
FROM
    directives r
JOIN
    recentTimestamp rt ON r.timestamp = rt.date
WHERE
  r.success_repaired != 0
GROUP BY
    r.id, r.name

panels.title: Directives having loops in configurations

targets.rawSql:
WITH recentTimestamp AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        timestamp as date
    FROM
        nodes
    ORDER BY date DESC limit 2
)
SELECT  n.hostname as "Hostname", AVG(n.success_repaired) as "Proportion of 'Repaired' (%)"
FROM
    nodes n
JOIN
    recentTimestamp rt ON n.timestamp = rt.date
WHERE
  n.success_repaired != 0
GROUP BY
    n.id, n.hostname

targets.rawSql:
select  DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(start_date, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%sZ'), '%Y-%m')   as 'Month', 
sum(failed_pkg) AS 'Failed updates',  
SUM(updated_pkg) as 'Updated packages'
from grafana.campaignEvents
GROUP BY Month
ORDER BY Month asc;

targets.rawSql:
select  DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(start_date, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%sZ'), '%Y-%m-01') as 'Date', sum(failed_pkg) as 'Failed updates',  SUM(updated_pkg) as 'Updated packages'
from grafana.campaignEvents
GROUP BY Date
ORDER BY Date;
